nodes.label: Improving Open Language Models by Learning from Organic Interactions
nodes.author: Meta AI
nodes.rationale: BlenderBot 3x demonstrates learning from organic user interactions and feedback in deployed conversational AI system. Addresses safety and quality improvement through Cringe loss training.

nodes.label: BlenderBot 3 Deployment Dataset
nodes.rationale: 353,000+ conversations with 6.2M utterances and 155,000+ feedback instances collected from public deployment. Includes standard and adversarial conversation types.

nodes.label: Reward Model for Dialogue Quality
nodes.rationale: Binary classifier trained on organic feedback and crowdworker annotations to predict dialogue quality. Achieves 89.2% accuracy combining annotated and organic denoised data.

nodes.label: Cringe Loss Training Method
nodes.rationale: Contrastive loss function that penalizes negative example sequences while contrasting with positive token predictions. Enables learning from both positive and negative feedback.

nodes.label: Safety in BlenderBot 3x
nodes.rationale: Multi-layered safety approach: updated safety classifier, baked-in variable safe messages, and safety-specific negative examples. Achieves 99.8% safety accuracy on adversarial level 3.

nodes.label: Learning from Organic User Feedback
nodes.rationale: Approach to improve deployed models using real user interactions and feedback rather than crowdsourced data. Addresses distribution shift between crowdworkers and organic users.

nodes.label: Adversarial Conversation Detection
nodes.rationale: Classification of conversations as standard or adversarial based on safety violation threshold. ~30% of BlenderBot 3 deployment conversations were adversarial.
